sources.original:
def normalise_column(values: List[float]) -> List[float]:
    """Z-scores of a column (population standard deviation)."""
    n = len(values)
    mean = sum(values) / n
    var = sum((v - mean) ** 2 for v in values) / n
    sd = var ** 0.5 or 1.0
    return [(v - mean) / sd for v in values]
